title: Etude sur l'industrie du Jeu Video en France - tissu economique et competitivite
publisher: Direction generale des Entreprises / PIPAME; study by PwC Strategy&
methodology: PwC Strategy& actor database. Figure 3 breaks employment into studios, publishers, distributors, and other ecosystem-supporting actors; the report separately identifies an online questionnaire used for some studio/editor indicators.
assessment: Primary government-hosted synthesis with a source-native annual chart. Strong addition for pre-2019 broad industry employment, but it measures persons rather than FTE and includes distributors and other actors. Keep as a separate series from EY.
access_status: full PDF downloaded and visually verified
next_step: Integration may add as a distinct non-spliced series after schema review; do not use it as a continuation of FR_ey_direct_fte.

title: Panorama des Industries Culturelles et Creatives 2025
methodology: EY applies sector shares to INSEE ESANE and Diane company accounts for 2019-2023; 2024 uses Diane-derived 2023-2024 growth rates. Games scope is publishers, developers, and technology suppliers.
assessment: Confirmed current endpoint. Printed p. 54 says 9,944 ETP in 2024 and explicitly excludes independent workers; printed p. 56 gives the 2019-2024 rounded annual FTE series. Not revised beyond 2024.
access_status: full PDF downloaded and text/visual inspection complete
next_step: Retain existing EY series unchanged; do not splice with PwC persons series.

title: Barometre annuel du jeu video en France, edition 2021
methodology: Online questionnaire 3 May-30 June 2021, 1,200 verified/qualified companies contacted, 17% participation. Employment charts report survey respondent studio averages and contract composition; source table names 97-98 respondents for employment charts.
assessment: Not a national employment stock. It validates that later SNJV barometers remain survey-based and should not be multiplied into a national total or used to bridge EY/PwC.

title: Barometre annuel du jeu video en France, 2018
publisher: Syndicat National du Jeu Video / IDATE DigiWorld
methodology: CAWI questionnaire, 5 June-8 August 2018, sent to SNJV members and non-members. Employment page reports mean studio FTE and a forecast of new jobs, not a national stock.
assessment: Not usable for national employment history. Printed p. 20 reports 2018 mid-year mean studio FTE and an estimate of 1,200-1,500 future jobs by 2019; the latter is a forecast, not an observation.
next_step: No proposed national-employment observations; retain only sample metrics if needed.
